description: This Java class 'VCard' provides functionality to import and export vCard data, transforming between vCard format and internal party/contact representations within the OFBiz framework. It handles parsing vCard files using the ez-vcard library, creating or updating party records, and generating vCard files from party data.

classes.name: VCard
classes.description: A utility class for importing and exporting contact information using vCard format within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: importVCard
methods.description: Reads a vCard file from a ByteBuffer input, parses its contact details using ez-vcard, and creates or updates party records in the OFBiz system. Supports handling addresses, emails, and phone numbers. It manages duplicate detection based on formatted name and stores party identification info.

methods.name: exportVCard
methods.description: Generates a vCard file (.vcf) for a given party ID by gathering the party's contact details, including name, address, phone, and email, then writes the vCard to a file in the specified directory.
